title: Battle of Casicola
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Casicola", at revision 1370436449, opens: "The battle of Casicola was an armed engagement between Portugal and the Kingdom of Ndongo on August 24, 1585, during the Angolan Wars. It resulted in an important Portuguese victory, that was decisive to the control the region around Luanda." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q138632220, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1585 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
